summary.pl: Mała paczka do sprawdzania launchera na Quilcie: kilka modów, shader, paczka zasobów i plik ustawień.
summary.en: A small pack for trying the launcher on Quilt: a few mods, a shader, a resource pack and a settings file.

mods.reason: Required by Mod Menu and Jade. Tagged for Fabric alone on Modrinth, and Quilt Loader runs it as it is — which is half of what this pack is here to exercise
Required by Mod Menu — its only caller here, so it is pinned client
Renderer. The other mod with no build tagged for Quilt
Shader loader — what makes the shader below something the game reads. A beta on purpose: 1.8.8, the last release for 1.21.1, asks for Sodium 0.6, and Sodium 0.8 refuses any Iris older than 1.8.13
Game-logic optimisations. Tagged for Quilt as well as Fabric, and ships to both sides
The list of what the loader actually loaded, one click from the title screen
Block and entity tooltip. Pinned client: nothing for a server to do

resourcePacks.reason: Ten kilobytes, and visible at a glance: grass that covers the sides of its block

shaders.reason: Half a megabyte, and the pack most players reach for first
